title: One Unified SLM · Training Progress
motivation: Three separate SLM workloads (MAI Profile, Quality, GEM story-assembly) each carried their own small fine-tune. The initiative consolidates them into ONE joint model fine-tuned over a merged train set, so all workloads share one served model and one inference footprint.

The 4-task joint model now folds in HPF query-extending too: MAI Profile + Quality + GEM + HPF over a merged ~570k-row train set, start on ~4B Qwen3 to prove orchestration end-to-end (swap to larger MoE later if Quality/HPF capacity gates).

The AML A100 pool hands every job exactly ONE GPU (confirmed via gpu_diag). To use the fleet's GPUs at once, the train set is split into K disjoint shards, each trained on one node, then recombined by weight-delta averaging (model soup):  final = base + mean_k(shard_k − base).
dataset: 4 task packs staged on cosmos under one_unified_slm/<task>/{train,val,test}.jsonl, merged by data_prepare into one joint SFT set. Actual joint train (verified by sampling) = MAI + GEM + HPF (~570k); Quality registered but NOT in the merged joint file (see note).
143,279 train · w=1 · ads user-profile (build + merge/classify interests). Path: abfss://maiprofilev3@maiprofilegen2blueshift.dfs.core.windows.net/one_unified_slm/mai_profile/train.jsonl

~10,646 train · w=3 · content-quality scoring (EL/ET/PO/PR). Path: abfss://maiprofilev3@maiprofilegen2blueshift.dfs.core.windows.net/one_unified_slm/quality/train.jsonl — NOT merged into joint (registry: merged:false 'no train set'; 0 quality rows sampled in joint).
142,608 train · w=1 · general-event structured extraction/ranking (storyline_group scenario). Path: abfss://maiprofilev3@maiprofilegen2blueshift.dfs.core.windows.net/one_unified_slm/gem/train.jsonl
285,000 train · w=2 · query-extending: profile → ranked extended-query groups. Path: abfss://maiprofilev3@maiprofilegen2blueshift.dfs.core.windows.net/one_unified_slm/hpf/train.jsonl
Each example keeps its natural chat structure (role/turn threads); task instruction injected as leading system message; layer_format generic; max_seq_len 8192 truncates the tail.
joint train split deterministically by seed 42 into K disjoint shards; each shard job slices its own lines on-node, no data re-upload.

summary: Pipeline: data_synth → data_prepare → sft → eval · Sharded single-GPU SFT over a 1-GPU-per-job A100 pool, merged by weight-delta averaging. Fixed an eval-time CUDA OOM by disabling eval during shard training. First 4-task (MAI+Quality+GEM+HPF) run converged to loss ~0.12 at step 68000/69648 (epoch ~1.95).
